description: This file contains unit tests for the RegistrationClientImpl class, verifying behavior such as cache interaction, message sending, and response handling in the context of a device registration client within an Eclipse-based project.

classes.name: RegistrationClientImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RegistrationClientImpl, testing registration assertions, caching, message handling, and response processing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing mocks and creating an instance of RegistrationClientImpl.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationAddsResponseToCacheOnCacheMiss
methods.description: Verifies that a cache miss triggers a registration request and caches the response.

methods.name: testAssertRegistrationInvokesServiceIfNoCacheConfigured
methods.description: Checks that without a cache, the registration is retrieved directly from the service.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationInfoReturnsValueFromCache
methods.description: Ensures that registration info is retrieved from cache when available.

methods.name: testGetRegistrationInfoIncludesRequiredParamsInRequest
methods.description: Confirms that the request message includes device ID and gateway ID.
